name: Beier catalogue entries
recordDescription: One full numbered catalogue entry and its locality on physical PDF pages 2–32. Include main, u-prefixed, a-prefixed entries and the three Katalognachtrag entries. Keep lettered subentries and finds inside their parent. Exclude section headings, continuations, numbered finds, references, figure captions and all later Fundlisten/Fundortverzeichnis. Preserve German text and abbreviations; never infer missing facts. catalogue_label: only the printed number/prefix (e.g. 29., u 1., a 1.), never locality/body. locality_and_findspot: opening locality plus findspot. fa_code: only the short classification immediately after FA. find_description: quote the first one or two sentences of the find context, at most 400 characters. museum_inventory: all collection/inventory references (Mus., LM, HK, Inv.-Nr.) from all subentries, one per item; ignore Mbl. map references; empty if absent. literature_references: one cited reference per item, from all subentries.
